name: '$(Date:yyyyMMdd)$(Rev:.r)'

# Use the Azure DevOps pipeline templates
resources:
  repositories:
    - repository: 'pipelines'
      type: 'git'
      name: 'Azure/template-pipelines'

trigger:
  batch: true
  branches:
    include:
      - develop
      - master
      - main

extends:
  template: "jobs/megalinter.yml@pipelines"
  parameters:
    megalinter_image_name: oxsecurity/megalinter-formatters
    megalinter_configuration:
      - name: DISABLE
        value: SPELL
    publish_to_sonarqube: true

FROM acrprdccr001.azurecr.io/library/traefik:3.4

COPY traefik.yaml /etc/traefik/

COPY dynamic/* /etc/traefik/dynamic/

EXPOSE 3001

# App Proxy

This microservice is a forward proxy routing incoming http requests to different backend services:

- default  --> ui
- /api     --> api
- /datahub --> datahub

The app proxy is based on [Traefik](https://traefik.io/traefik/)

resources:
  repositories:
    - repository: mesx-ops-pipelines
      type: git
      name: MES_X.0/mesx-ops-pipelines

trigger:
  branches:
    include:
      - refs/tags/*
      - main
      - ci/*
  paths:
    exclude:
      - README.md
variables:
  isMain: $[eq(variables['Build.SourceBranch'], 'refs/heads/main')]
  caAppName: app-proxy

stages:
  - stage: Build
    jobs:
      - template: build/jobs/jobs-docker-build.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
        parameters:
          folder: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)
          repository: mesx/app-proxy
          npmauth: false

  - stage: Dev
    condition: and(succeeded(), eq(variables.isMain, true))
    jobs:
      - template: deploy/jobs/jobs-container-apps-deploy.yml@mesx-ops-pipelines
        parameters:
          azureSubscription: spn-dev-inf-mes
          pipelineDeploymentEnvironment: app_cloud_dev_mes
          containerAppName: ca-gptmpxn01-eun-dev-$(caAppName)
          containerAppResourceGroupName: rg-gptmpxn01-dev-eun-mes-01
